Evan Lee (AcreMetrics): Hey, quick panicked notewe're demoing a long chat flow and the client throws HTTP 400 with context_length_exceeded and payload_too_large. Demo in 2 hours, can anyone help?

Ben Ortiz: Which model + hosted/dedicated? Also paste the raw error body if you can (redact keys).

Evan Lee (AcreMetrics): Hosted, using redwood-v2-medium. Error response from our client:
```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
Content-Type: application/json
{
  \"error\": \"payload_too_large\",
  \"message\": \"context_length_exceeded: total_tokens=10240 max_context_tokens=8192 truncated=true\",
  \"detail\": \"request_body_bytes=1,574,328 max_request_size_bytes=1048576\"
}
```

Amy Carter (SE): Thanks. Two things hit here: model context cap (looks like 8192 tokens) and the platform gateway request size (~1MB). They27re separate limits: tokens vs raw bytes.

Priya Nair (Solutions): Quick remediation options for demos:
- Trim older turns or create rolling summaries every N turns.
- Offload big attachments/transcripts to S3 and pass a short reference.
- Use the chunked streams API so each HTTP POST stays <1MB.

Mike Huang (Eng-oncall): Infra note: Hosted front door enforces 1,048,576 bytes per request (Nginx/gateway). We can temporarily raise it for a specific API key with ops approval, but that does nothing for model context.

Evan Lee (AcreMetrics): Can you share the chunked API pattern?

Amy Carter (SE): Minimal flow: create a stream id, append chunks, then generate referencing the stream. Example: 
```
POST /v1/streams { \"stream_id\": \"acre-demo-01\" }
POST /v1/streams/append // chunk 1
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <key>
Body: { \"stream_id\": \"acre-demo-01\", \"chunk\": \"...base64...\" }
...repeat...
POST /v1/generate { \"model\": \"redwood-v2-medium\", \"stream_id\": \"acre-demo-01\", \"instructions\": \"...\" }
```
This keeps each HTTP payload small; server reassembles and can apply KV caching.

Samira Patel (Security): Also flag: if you store full plaintext histories in S3 or in summaries, ensure PII redaction or apply DLP rules. Summaries should avoid copying SSNs/emails verbatim.

Ben Ortiz: Any quick config we can flip today to get them through the demo without rewriting client?

Mike Huang (Eng-oncall): Ops can approve a temporary increase to 2MB for the customer key for a short window. I can start the runbook now (ticket OPS-4621) but will need an owner to ack logs/alerts while it's open. Even with 2MB, they'll still hit the 8192 token model limit if they keep sending full history.

Evan Lee (AcreMetrics): What does truncated=true mean? Did the runtime drop earlier chat turns silently?

Amy Carter (SE): truncated=true indicates the request stitcher trimmed earliest tokens server-side to fit the model context. The runtime does that to avoid failure, but it means history got dropped. Best to compress/summarise earlier turns client-side so you control what27s kept.

Priya Nair (Solutions): Quick lightweight approach for POC: every 6 turns run an inline summariser that replaces the last 6 turns with a 60-120 token summary. Keeps context useful and reduces tokens dramatically. We can share a small Node/Python snippet.

Ben Ortiz: Cost question: will chunking or summarisation change billing materially during the POC?

Amy Carter (SE): You still pay for tokens processed. Chunking only helps with HTTP limits, not token billing. Summaries reduce tokens so they lower cost. Switching to a larger-context model (if available) may increase price-per-token; I'll attach a short delta chart for AcreMetrics after the call.

Mike Huang (Eng-oncall): Ops approved a temporary bump to 2MB for their key for 3 hours. Applied; ticket OPS-4621 closed. Reminder: this is a short-lived exception with extra logging enabled.

Evan Lee (AcreMetrics): Demo resumed 27no 400s27. We'll implement rolling summarisation + move transcripts to S3 for the remainder of the POC. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

deploy-bot: Heads up: do not paste secrets or API keys in-channel. All keys should be redacted.

Ben Ortiz: Great. Amy, Priya 26 Mike: can one of you drop a 1-page POC checklist (summarise strategy, S3 pattern, chunk example, brief cost note) and we27ll forward to AcreMetrics?

Amy Carter (SE): On it 26 will post the snippet and cost delta in this thread within 30 minutes.

Evan Lee (AcreMetrics): Thanks everyone, saved the demo. We'll follow up with logs if we see more truncation. :thumbsup:

(End of thread)
